purpose: Teach: 本紙/減速/同市/出馬/課せ/部類/大綱/適性

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、本紙の取材依頼を承諾しろ
lines.en: Accept the interview request from the newspaper.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative. Each word lands with quiet weight. No inflection wasted. The tone of someone used to being obeyed without explanation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市場の成長減速に備えております
lines.en: Yes. We're preparing for the market slowdown ahead.
lines.style: Measured, respectful. Precise enunciation on the key terms. Steady rhythm — the cadence of someone reporting facts they've already verified. A slight nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、同市での展開を加速しろ
lines.en: Accelerate our expansion in that market.
lines.style: Direct, economical. Sharp attack on the verb. No softening. The brevity itself is the authority — a man who doesn't need to elaborate.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。次期社長への出馬を取締役会で決定します
lines.en: Understood. The board will decide on the next president's candidacy.
lines.style: Formal, deferential. Slightly elevated register — acknowledging the weight of what's being stated. Crisp delivery, no hesitation. The voice of someone documenting a significant decision.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新人にも適正な責任を課せ
lines.en: Assign appropriate responsibility to new staff as well.
lines.style: Controlled, expectant. A slight emphasis on 「適正」in the voice — fairness matters here. The tone of someone testing whether the message will be understood correctly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。これは特別案件の部類に入ります
lines.en: Understood. This falls into the special project category.
lines.style: Confirming, precise. Slightly formal register — matching the elevated context. Even cadence, no apology in the tone. Clear categorization.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新事業の大綱を取締役会に提示しろ
lines.en: Present the new business framework to the board.
lines.style: Clipped final directive. Sharp on the verb. No question mark at the end — this is instruction, not suggestion. The tone of someone moving to close the meeting.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の適性検査を継続実施します
lines.en: Yes. We'll continue implementing staff aptitude assessments.
lines.style: Concluding tone — slightly lowered, finishing note. Respectful but not deferential. The last word carries a sense of closure. Steady and assured.
